definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.

caveats: Figures are as reported by each nursing home on its Connecticut DSS 'Annual Report of Long-Term Care Facility' for the cost year ending September 30. They are the home's own filing, before DSS audit or rate-setting adjustments, and are not Medicaid-allowable costs.
Figures were read from the published PDFs by software. Scanned reports were read with OCR. Each figure is checked against the totals printed on the same report; figures that fail a check are marked.

Direct care follows the DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and nurse-aide salaries, related fringe benefits, and nursing pool (agency) costs. Fringe benefits are not reported by job, so the direct-care share of fringe is allocated in proportion to nursing salaries.
Owner, officer and related-party names, addresses and amounts are shown as written on the report and in CMS ownership data. Addresses may be business or personal addresses as filed.
Being listed as an owner or related party is not an allegation of wrongdoing. Spending figures are not a measure of care quality.

largest_review_adjustments.name: Other Employee Health And Welfare Benefits
Other Employee Health And Welfare Benefits

dss_review_definitions.home_adjustment: Amounts the home itself removed on its cost report (adjustment column), for example bad debt, pharmacy or occupational therapy that Medicaid does not cover.
dss_review_definitions.moved_between_lines: True when a review decrease on one line is matched by an equal increase on another: the cost was reclassified, not removed.
dss_review_definitions.review_adjustment: Changes made to the cost report in DSS's review (columns marked MSLC / M&S in DSS's data, DSS's cost-report review contractor). Negative removes cost from what DSS counts; positive adds it back. The data shows the change, not the reason.
dss_review_definitions.medicaid_revenue_net: Connecticut Medicaid room, board and care revenue the home reported, minus its Medicaid contractual allowance: what the home recorded as due from Medicaid for the year.
dss_review_definitions.per_diem: The Medicaid daily rate DSS set for the state fiscal year (July to June). Provisional: DSS can revise it after review or audit.
